data.name: Sample - Proofpoint Threat Response - 1.0.1
data.description: Proofpoint Threat Response is a solution designed to help organizations manage and respond to cybersecurity threats. It provides tools and features to identify, investigate, and remediate security incidents.

workflows.name: Get Incident By ID
workflows.description: Retrieves the metadata of the specified incident from Proofpoint Threat Response.

arguments.title: Proofpoint Threat Response: Get Incident By ID

workflows.name: Get Indicators List
workflows.description: Retrieves all indicators from the specified list.

arguments.title: Proofpoint Threat Response: Get Indicators List

workflows.name: Add User To Incident
workflows.description: Assigns a user to the specified incident, as either a target or an attacker.

arguments.title: Proofpoint Threat Response: Add User To Incident

workflows.name: Delete Indicator
workflows.description: Removes an indicator from Proofpoint Threat Response based on the input parameters you have specified.

workflows.name: Add Comment To Incident
workflows.description: Adds a comment to an existing incident in Proofpoint Threat Response, based on the incident ID you have specified.

arguments.title: Proofpoint Threat Response: Add Comment To Incident

workflows.name: Add Indicators
workflows.description: Adds the specified indicators to the specified list.

workflows.name: Block URL
workflows.description: Blocks the specified URLs by adding them to the specified URL block list.

workflows.name: Update Comment To Incident
workflows.description: Updates a comment on an existing incident in Proofpoint Threat Response, based on the incident ID you have specified.

arguments.title: Proofpoint Threat Response: Update Comment To Incident

workflows.name: Block File Hash
workflows.description: Blocks the specified file hashes by adding them to the specified file hash block list.

arguments.title: Proofpoint Threat Response: Block File Hash

workflows.name: Search Indicator
workflows.description: Retrieves indicators from the specified list, based on the filter you have specified.

workflows.name: Close Incident
workflows.description: Closes an incident in Proofpoint Threat Response based on the input parameters you have specified.

workflows.name: Get Incidents List
workflows.description: Retrieves metadata for all incidents from Proofpoint Threat Response, based on the filter criteria you have specified, such as the state of the incident or its time of closure.

arguments.title: Proofpoint Threat Response: Get Incidents List

workflows.name: Ingest Alert
workflows.description: Ingests an alert into Proofpoint Threat Response based on the input parameters you have specified.

workflows.name: Block Domain
workflows.description: Blocks the specified domains by adding them to the specified domain block list.

workflows.name: Verify Quarantine
workflows.description: Verifies whether the specified email has been quarantined.

workflows.name: Block IP Addresses
workflows.description: Blocks the specified IP addresses by adding them to the specified IP address block list.

arguments.title: Proofpoint Threat Response: Block IP Addresses
